name: Maya
label: Music-only listener buried by podcast clutter
who: I use Spotify almost entirely for music and rarely, if ever, listen to podcasts there. I was a long-time premium member on a family plan, but the podcast-heavy home screen and library made me cancel.
value_for_money: Says the podcast-cluttered interface makes the subscription feel less worth it; one post describes cancelling a family plan over the UI, and they do not discuss price directly.
loyalty: Stays for finding music through search and playlists; would leave if the home screen and library keep prioritizing podcasts they never play.
pain_points: Podcasts pinned to the top of home and library
Cannot permanently hide podcasts, only filter them
One accidental podcast play adds it to Your Shows and recommendations
Daily Mixes buried after the UI change
likes: Search as the main way to find music
Don't play this option on artist pages
tone: Frustrated and sarcastic, venting in long complaints with occasional all-caps for emphasis.
